crop.notes: Whole boxed advertisement 'Great Fight for $10,000 and the World's Title'.

ocr.notes: Gist right but the 'No. 4 in the series of Great Stories of the Ring' sentence and the 'Part II, February 4' line are missing; typos 'Pilly Murphy' and 'Grinhbam'.

title.suggested: Great Fight for $10,000 and the World's Title

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Star advertised that next Sunday's paper would carry Prof. Bill Clark's story, told to Billy Murphy, of the Tom Allen and Jem Mace fight for $10,000 and the world's title in New Orleans.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'Tuesday, The St. Louis Star, January 23, 1912', page 8; the box is at the top of the second column. Same advertisement as 225 and 227.

notes: A promotional box for the Star's 'Great Stories of the Ring' No. 4 by Prof. Bill Clark. It names Allen as the winner; Jem Mace won the 1870 fight, so no fight facts are taken from it. Repeat of the ad in 225.
